Say Hello to Your Future向未來問好.title: 第一課單字
Say Hello to Your Future向未來問好.content:
• 1.exciting adj. 令人興奮的；刺激的 [反義詞] boring, unexciting • 例句：Tony watched an exciting live basketball game last night. Tony 昨晚看了一場刺激的現場籃球賽。

  • 2.excited adj. 興奮的 [反義詞] bored, indifferent • 例句：All the students are excited about the field trip. 所有學生都對這次校外教學感到很興奮。

  • 3.proud adj. 驕傲的；感到自豪的 [反義詞] ashamed, humble • 例句：Mr. and Mrs. Clinton are proud of their daughter because she is honest. Clinton 夫婦以他們的女兒為榮，因為她很誠實。

  • 4.challenge n. [C] 挑戰 [反義詞] ease, comfort • 例句：Henry always faces challenges in a brave way. Henry 總是勇敢地面對挑戰。

  • 5.nervous adj. 緊張的 [反義詞] relaxed, calm • 例句：Tom is nervous about the final exam. Tom 對期末考很緊張。

  • 6.different adj. 不同的 [反義詞] same, similar • 例句：Asian elephants are different from African elephants. 亞洲象和非洲象不一樣。

  • 7.difference n. [U][C] 差異 [反義詞] similarity, sameness • 例句：There is little difference in looks between the two sisters. 這兩個姐妹的外表差異不大。

  • 8.awesome adj. 很棒的；令人驚嘆的 [反義詞] awful, terrible • 例句：The magic show was awesome. I enjoyed it a lot. 那場魔術表演很棒。我很喜歡。

  • 9.surprised adj. 驚訝的 [反義詞] unimpressed, expected • 例句：The fans were surprised at the famous singer's sudden marriage. 歌迷們對這位知名歌手的突然結婚感到很驚訝。

  • 10.surprise n. [C] / v. 驚訝；使驚訝 [反義詞] expectation • 例句：To our surprise, Andy won first place in the race. 令我們驚訝的是，Andy 在比賽中獲得了第一名。

  • 11.interested adj. 有興趣的 [反義詞] bored, uninterested • 例句：Steve is interested in playing the guitar. Steve 對彈吉他有興趣。

  • 12.interesting adj. 有趣的 [反義詞] boring, dull • 例句：Ms. White told the kids an interesting story. White 女士對孩子們說了一個有趣的故事。

  • 13.decision n. [C] 決定 [反義詞] indecision, hesitation • 例句：Before Judy makes a decision, she talks about it with her mother. Judy 在做決定前，她會和母親討論。

  • 14.decide vi. vt. 決定 [反義詞] hesitate, delay • 例句：Stacy decided not to buy the dress because it was too expensive. Stacy 決定不買這件洋裝，因為太貴了。

  • 15.upset adj. 難過的；沮喪的 [反義詞] happy, pleased • 例句：Hanna's cat died a few days ago, so she was quite upset. Hanna 的貓幾天前死了，所以她十分難過。

  • 16.trust vt. n. 相信；信任 [反義詞] distrust, doubt • 例句：We can't trust Ben because he likes to tell lies. 我們不能信任 Ben，因為他喜歡說謊。

  • 17.believe vt. 相信 [反義詞] disbelieve, doubt • 例句：I can't believe it! I just took a picture with my favorite actor. 我真不敢相信！我剛剛跟我最喜歡的演員拍了一張照片。

  • 18.perfect adj. 完美的；理想的 [反義詞] flawed, imperfect, terrible • 例句：The weather today is perfect. Let's go to the beach! 今天的天氣很好。我們去海灘吧！

  • 19.certainly adv. 必定；確定地 [反義詞] uncertainly, doubtfully • 例句：Joe studies very hard, so he will certainly pass the exam. Joe 很用功，所以他一定會通過考試。

  • 20.unforgettable adj. 令人難忘的 [反義詞] forgettable, ordinary • 例句：My one-month trip to Italy on my own was unforgettable. 我獨自去義大利一個月的旅行令人難忘。

  • 21.memory n. [C][U] 回憶；記憶 [反義詞] forgetfulness, amnesia • 例句：Every time Anna looks at those photos, she thinks of the sweet memories of her high school life. 每次 Anna 看那些照片，她就想起高中生活的甜蜜回憶。
